title: Well-Tempered Clavier I: Prelude No. 6 in D minor
video_use_ideas: Driving triplets for a turbulent or high-pressure segment.
legal_notes: Composition PD worldwide (J. S. Bach d.1750). Mutopia piece 538 ('Das Wohltemperierte Clavier I, Praeludium VI', for Harpsichord, Piano); licence shown as Public Domain on the piece page, in the Mutopia RDF and in the .ly header (placed in the public domain by typesetter Davide Castellone). Edition source: Breitkopf & Hartel, 1866. Preview is an own FluidSynth (FluidR3_GM) render of the Mutopia MIDI, not a human performance; no recording in this row.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
